one_liner.zh: 检查并恢复 DSH profile 配置，附带运行状态面板。
one_liner.en: Diagnoses and repairs DSH profiles with a runtime health dashboard.

local: Standalone commands invoke the local dsh CLI or its installed bin.js.
The plugin reads and writes $DSH_HOME/storages/brockdsaver-rescue.jsonl and may modify profile cordis.patch.yml files during recovery.
